sources.title: Linf-elix/albef-contrastive · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Overview This repository is a compact, custom PyTorch implementation of Albef for Contrastive. The nano configuration is intended for code review, smoke tests, and small controlled experiments rather than as a production-ready pretrained release.

sources.title: szwagner/my-contrastive · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: A research-oriented Albef prototype targeting Contrastive. The included small setup documents defaults and file formats without presenting unverified performance numbers.

sources.title: [2107.07651] Align before Fuse: Vision and Language Representation ...
sources.snippet: In this paper, we introduce a contrastive loss to ALign the image and text representations BEfore Fusing (ALBEF) them through cross-modal attention, which enables more grounded vision and language representation learning. Unlike most existing methods, our method does not require bounding box annotations nor high-resolution images.
